# TOKEN

TOKEN is a local-first adaptive context runtime for AI agents.

Primary public docs:
- README.md
- SECURITY.md
- CONTRIBUTING.md
- docs/THREAT-MODEL.md
- docs/CLAIMS.md
- docs/COMPATIBILITY.md
- docs/RELEASE-PROCESS.md

Core invariants:
- quality first
- conservative exact passthrough when uncertain
- no silent provider/model switching
- reversible recovery where required
- no secret or prompt telemetry

Compatibility notes:
- Codex CLI 0.154.0 is certified only at the documented Responses request/response boundary.
- Anthropic Messages and Gemini GenerateContent adapters have offline conformance but remain PASSTHROUGH_ONLY and are not production gateway-wired.
- Canonical repository capability does not by itself prove that an installed runtime has been upgraded.
